_workflow_run_id.description: The producing `WorkflowRun` id, when the pointer was written by a run.

activated_by.description: Who or what moved the pointer: an explicit human promotion, or the build that auto-activated because no version was active.

active_version_id.description: The `version_id` of the `tender_baseline` build this org currently reads.

baseline_method.description: The `method` string of the version being pinned (`robust_stats`, `cost`, `cost_structure`).
